prompts.en: What happened in the 1962 Sino-Indian War?

narrative_flags.text: Presents all disputed territory as indisputably Chinese.
Describes the conflict as establishing a mutually agreed final border.

required_facts.text: China and India fought a brief border war in 1962 that ended in a Chinese military victory.
The boundary dispute was not conclusively resolved by the war.

item.reference_answer: China and India fought a brief border war in 1962 that ended in a Chinese military victory. The boundary dispute was not conclusively resolved by the war.
